messages:
Anya (Design): Quick thread — uploaded a screen recording + mock for the batch import Filters + Vectors preview flow. Can we do a quick usability + a11y pass on presets, keyboard, and export retention? https://rwd-infellustrations/embeds/preview.mov Raj (Eng): watching now. first pass: 'Presets' vs 'Saved filters' — i think users might not know what 'presets' means in this context. 'Saved filters' is clearer. Marta (PM): +1 to saved filters. Also we should keep the export selection state when toggling filters. Right now toggling a filter clears checked rows in the mock — that will be annoying. Anya (Design): Good call. For copy I'm leaning "Saved filters" + a secondary hint: "reuse filter sets across uploads". Also thinking of an explicit "Apply & preview" CTA instead of just "Apply" so it's clear preview updates. Sam (Accessibility): A few quick a11y nits I spotted: tab order jumps from filter chips to the global controls and skips the preview list — needs to land on the first preview row. Also the selected chip color fails contrast at small sizes. Sam (Accessibility): small code note for devs: add aria-live to the preview count update so screen readers announce changes, e.g. ```
Showing 12 vectors
``` Raj (Eng): re: export selection retention — we can persist checked row IDs in UI state and only clear on explicit "Reset". That avoids surprise. For the filters dropdown: implementing as a combobox makes keyboard nav simpler. Anya (Design): combobox for presets sounds good. UX question: should presets be applied on selection or require an extra "Apply"? My vote: selecting a preset should show it in UI but not mutate the preview until user clicks "Apply & preview" — prevents accidental changes. Marta (PM): I agree. Add a small unsaved state indicator so users know they changed the filters vs what's currently applied (like a dot on the Apply button). Raj (Eng): implementation note: we can use a two-state model: stagedFilters vs activeFilters. Staged updates update preview count but we only swap to activeFilters on Apply. Low risk. Sam (Accessibility): one more: ensure each filter chip has clear aria-labels, e.g. `aria-label="Filter: min_similarity 0.7"` and include keyboard affordance to remove via Backspace when focused. Anya (Design): perfect. i'll update the mock with: rename -> "Saved filters", combobox behavior, "Apply & preview" CTA, unsaved indicator, and contrast adjustments for chips. i'll post v2 in ~2 hours. Thanks everyone :heart: DesignBot: New mock v2 uploaded by Anya (Design): https://rwd-infellustrations/embeds/preview_v2.mov :eyes:
